_comment: racePassword is the way to lock this server down: any player who types /raceui and enters it is a race admin until he leaves. Leave it empty and EVERY player may start and abort races, overwrite grids and presets, and run the championship. raceAdmins matches the BeamMP name, which rotates on every game start while BeamMP login is broken -- an entry there will not match the same person tomorrow. The plugin reads this file at server start only.
